subject: 5 mirrors live — the value story, measured
intro: Five businesses, five premium mirrors, all revealable, all in the wss-test namespace. The engine showed its real speed today: when Music City and ENCO needed their own photos placed, the full re-mirror took 23 and 18 seconds each. Every number below was measured on the live site — nothing estimated, nothing invented.
